Direct location sharing needs a UnifiedPush distributor app (for example ntfy). Install one from your app store or F-Droid, open it once, then reopen this screen.

SOS Ring processes call and contact data on your device.

Location sharing is peer-to-peer over UnifiedPush. You choose the push distributor (e.g. ntfy). The distributor relays only ciphertext and cannot read your location.

Coordinates are end-to-end encrypted using Web Push encryption (ECDH P-256 + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-128-GCM). Each message is signed with a per-device ECDSA P-256 key held in the Android Keystore (non-exportable), so the recipient can verify the sender.

Pairing is explicit via QR code. Location sharing is off by default per contact.

This is NOT forward-secret and does NOT protect against a compromised phone, malware, screenshots, or keyloggers.

No analytics, no tracking, no ads.
